observations: body (Betelgeuze, Naṣīr ad-dīn): «f. 88.v.» is printed with a period after 88; a short stroke is printed above, between «وهو» and «يضرب»; not transcribed.
body (Betelgeuze, aṣ-Ṣūfī): the Arabic «يضرب الى الخوصى» is divided between the two lines, as printed; the l of «l’épaule» is printed broken.
body (Betelgeuze, Ulugh Beg): «زوشن» is printed so (for «روشن»), with the dot of zāy; «مرخى» is printed so (for «سرخى»), the first letter in the form of an initial mīm.

body (Sirius): «splendcris» (Naṣīr ad-dīn) is printed so, for «splendoris»; «Vh» (al-Battānī) is printed without a period; in Ulugh Beg «كاب» is printed so (for «كلب»), the bāʾ standing apart from the alif, as «قاب» p. 285.

body (Arabic): «الخوصى» is printed with the final yāʾ without dots in the testimonies, in the first line of the paragraph and as the first of the corrupt forms, «الخوصي» with them in the conjecture; «اليمانيّة» with the shadda.

body (colour words): the shadda is printed as a short stroke above the final yāʾ, as elsewhere in this type; the kasra under the mīm of «قِرْمِزيّ» is printed small and broken; the nūn of «أُرْجُوَانِيّ» and «زَعْفَرَانِيّ» and the jīm of «بَنَفْسَجِيّ» are printed without kasra.
body (paragraph): «cúm» is printed so, with an accent; the final e of «saepe» is printed blotted, like o; the italic x of «lexicis» is printed in the open form of the type, like «.r».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
